info.title: RegiGov API
info.description: CER device register sandbox API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Sign in with POST /auth/login (local provider) and use the returned token as a bearer token. Each operation lists the permission it needs (x-permission); x-enabled-by marks routes that exist only when a config flag is on. The service inventory is docs/service-inventory.md.

bearerAuth.description: Token from POST /auth/login (local provider) or an Entra External ID access token.
